summary.verdict: The page scores an F with a score of 13, indicating major accessibility barriers that prevent many visitors from using the site. Critical failures affect core navigation and content perception, meaning large numbers of users will be blocked entirely.
quickWins: Add descriptive alt attributes to all images
Provide a visible, descriptive label for the select element
Give each link clear, readable link text
Add a lang attribute to the <html> tag

priorities.why: 33 images lack alt text, blocking screen‑reader users from understanding visual content.
priorities.title: Images must have alternative text

priorities.why: The single form control has no label, preventing screen‑reader, cognitive and motor users from interacting with it.
priorities.title: Select element must have an accessible name

priorities.why: 7 links contain no readable text, making navigation impossible for screen‑reader and keyboard users.
priorities.title: Links must have discernible text

summary.mostAffected: Screen‑reader users, people with low vision or color blindness, and users with cognitive or motor impairments are most impacted by the current barriers.
